_note: Recent news on the home page. Items are sorted automatically by the sort date (YYYY-MM-DD), newest first, so new items can go anywhere in the list. The date field is what visitors see. kind is one of article, event, report, award (sets the small icon and label).

items.title: CADRE at the Earth Institute coffee morning
items.text: I introduced CADRE at the UCD Earth Institute’s coffee morning for its new Strategic Interdisciplinary Award projects, alongside BRIDGE and LEAF.

items.title: New article in Environmental Research Letters
items.text: Regional El Niño patterns shape how wheat-flour prices respond to floods, droughts, and storms.

items.title: New article in Civil Wars
items.text: With Kasia Houghton, on how mediators who also fund rebel groups shape conflict resolution.

items.title: Two papers at APSA 2026
items.text: I presented work on climate law adoption (with Tahlia Mullen) and rare earths and armed conflict (with Päivi Lujala).

items.title: New article in Humanities and Social Sciences Communications
items.text: Floods and storms raise battle events, and food price instability amplifies the effect.

items.title: CADRE named an Earth Institute Strategic Priority
items.text: CADRE won a UCD Earth Institute Strategic Interdisciplinary Award and was named a Strategic Priority for 2026–27.

items.title: MEND policy brief: Mediation in 2025
items.text: With Mateja Peter, Kasia Houghton, and Sanja Badanjak, I track mediation across overlapping conflict systems in 2025 using MEND data.

items.title: Speaking at PeaceRep’s closing conference
items.text: I spoke on the Mediation Futures and PeaceTech panel at “Time to Make a Change” in Edinburgh, marking five years of PeaceRep research.

items.title: Presenting at the CCEW Symposium, Berlin
items.text: I’m presenting at the Center for Crisis Early Warning symposium, “Conflict Early Warning in Times of Power Competition: Limits and Challenges.”

items.title: New article in Global Environmental Politics
items.text: A difference-in-differences study of how hydropower development shapes conflict.

items.title: Presenting at ESOC-ReCIPE, Paris
items.text: The Empirical Studies of Conflict and CEPR ReCIPE annual meeting, at the University of Chicago in Paris and the Paris School of Economics.

items.title: Interdisciplinary workshop on climate and conflict, Milan
items.text: A workshop on climate change, natural resources, and conflict at the Politecnico di Milano.

items.title: Presenting at SPSA, New Orleans
items.text: The Southern Political Science Association annual meeting, including its Conference-within-a-Conference on crises and disasters.

items.title: Talk on the academic job market
items.text: I spoke at UCD SPIRe’s Early Career Researcher Forum on navigating the current academic job market.

items.title: SPIRe Seminar, University College Dublin
items.text: I presented “From Disaster to Dispute in the DRC: Climate’s Role in Resource Wars.”

items.title: Presenting at PECE, Vancouver
items.text: The Political Economy of Climate and Environment conference.

items.title: New article in Climate Policy
items.text: With Tofigh Maboudi, on when climate policies are adopted and how timing shapes adaptive resilience.

items.title: New article in Political Research Quarterly
items.text: With Tofigh Maboudi, on whether constitutional rights shape climate litigation outcomes.

items.title: New article in the Journal of Peace Research
items.text: With Santiago Sosa and Molly Melin, on economic provisions in peace agreements and the durability of peace.

items.title: New article in npj Climate Action
items.text: Isolating the climate adaptation measures that matter in New England.

items.title: LSE Sustainable Social Policy Workshop
items.text: The inaugural workshop of LSE’s Sustainable Social Policy cluster.

items.title: New article in the Review of International Political Economy
items.text: From garments to grievances: urban growth and economic shocks in rapidly industrialising economies.

items.title: Poster at PolMeth Europe, LSE
items.text: I presented a poster on the geography of conflict mediation.
